title: WOLF
tagline: A whole year at the gym!
blurb: A whole year at the gym! Twelve sessions and four big lifting days, with red dots for slackers and a bell to ring for every new best. Sweat through the summer heatwave, dress up for December and see who is Member of the Year. Pick up later with your password.
controls: Beat; start a set, drink, ring the bell

review.verdict: A whole year of muscle for your money, but it's flabby round the edges. A few more reps needed.

quote.text: Put the work in, though, and the board does climb

credits.name: Norm Crabtree, Prue Fairley and Mick Dunsby for INK & PAPER
